summary_md: **Max | AI Wool ([@maxbrooks_sg](https://x.com/maxbrooks_sg/status/2116084307408163298))** points to **FreeVideo**, which runs MiniMax H3 open weights locally through ComfyUI on 8 GB VRAM plus 16 GB RAM (Apple silicon in preview) for text/image-to-video clips over a minute; the H3 license excludes the US, EU, UK and Korea ([FlashML-org/FreeVideo](https://github.com/FlashML-org/FreeVideo)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - FlashML-org/FreeVideo: Make videos on the computer you already own. FreeVideo runs MiniMax H3 in as little as 8 GB of VRAM and 16 GB of RAM, and adapts its acceleration path to your hardware.

relevance: Local video generation on modest hardware, with an important license caveat.
